events.title: Elvis Presley's Death Anniversary
events.blurb: On this day in 1977, we remember the King of Rock and Roll, Elvis Presley, who passed away at the age of 42.

angles.name: King's Legacy
angles.copy: It's 49 years since we lost Elvis Presley, but his music and influence are as strong as ever. What's your go-to Elvis track?

events.title: The Beatles release Abbey Road
events.blurb: On this day in 1969, The Beatles released their iconic eleventh studio album, 'Abbey Road'.

angles.name: Abbey Road Icon
angles.copy: It's 57 years since The Beatles gave us 'Abbey Road'. That album cover is still one of the most famous ever, right?

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: Chrissie Hynde, the legendary frontwoman of The Pretenders, celebrates her 75th birthday today.

angles.name: Pretenders Icon
angles.copy: Happy 75th birthday to the one and only Chrissie Hynde! Her voice and attitude with The Pretenders are truly iconic. What's your favourite Pretenders tune?

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Oasis frontman and rock 'n' roll star Liam Gallagher celebrates his 54th birthday today.

angles.name: Mad For It Birthday
angles.copy: Our kid Liam Gallagher is 54 today! From Oasis anthems to his solo hits, he's still bringing the rock 'n' roll. What's your favourite Liam moment?

events.title: John Lennon released 'Imagine'
events.blurb: On this day in 1975, John Lennon's powerful anthem 'Imagine' was released as a single in the UK.

angles.name: Imagine The Message
angles.copy: John Lennon's 'Imagine' was released as a UK single on this day in 1975. A song that still resonates with its message of peace and unity. What does 'Imagine' mean to you?

events.title: The first iPod released
events.blurb: On this day in 2001, Apple unveiled the very first iPod, revolutionising how we listen to music on the go.

angles.name: iPod Nostalgia
angles.copy: Remember the first iPod? It's 25 years since Apple dropped this game-changer, putting '1,000 songs in your pocket'. What was the first album you loaded onto yours?

events.title: James Bond Day
events.blurb: Today marks James Bond Day, celebrating the anniversary of the world premiere of the first Bond film, 'Dr. No', in 1962.

angles.name: Shaken Not Stirred
angles.copy: Happy James Bond Day! From iconic gadgets to unforgettable theme tunes, 007 has given us so much. Who's your favourite Bond and what's the best Bond song?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: We remember John Lennon, who would have celebrated his 86th birthday today.

angles.name: Remembering Lennon
angles.copy: On what would have been his 86th birthday, we're remembering the incredible John Lennon. His music and message continue to inspire generations.

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: Legendary comedian and actor John Cleese, best known for Monty Python and Fawlty Towers, celebrates his 87th birthday today.

angles.name: Comedy Legend
angles.copy: Happy 87th birthday to the brilliant John Cleese! A true titan of British comedy, from Python to Fawlty Towers. What's your favourite John Cleese moment?

events.title: The Beatles release the 'White Album'
events.blurb: On this day in 1968, The Beatles released their self-titled double album, famously known as the 'White Album'.

angles.name: White Album Anniversary
angles.copy: It's 58 years since The Beatles unleashed the 'White Album' – a sprawling, experimental masterpiece. What are your standout tracks from this iconic double LP?

events.title: Freddie Mercury's Death Anniversary
events.blurb: On this day in 1991, we remember the iconic Queen frontman, Freddie Mercury, who passed away at the age of 45.

angles.name: Remembering Freddie
angles.copy: 35 years ago today, the world lost Freddie Mercury. His unparalleled showmanship and incredible voice continue to define rock music. What's your favourite Queen anthem?

events.title: The Beatles release 'Rubber Soul'
events.blurb: On this day in 1965, The Beatles released their groundbreaking sixth studio album, 'Rubber Soul'.

angles.name: Rubber Soul Influence
angles.copy: 59 years ago, The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' dropped, marking a significant shift in their sound. An album that influenced countless artists. What's your favourite track from it?
